title: Accessibility-Tree Browser Automation and E2E Test Generation
oneLiner: Microsoft's Playwright MCP server exposes structured browser accessibility snapshots to AI agents, enabling deterministic web navigation, form testing, and Playwright test script generation without vision models.
evidenceDetail: The provider's own documentation describes this workflow, its requirements, and its setup steps. Zyvibe checked the linked source on 2026-11-21 and has not reproduced the workflow.
whatItDoes: Microsoft's Playwright MCP server exposes structured browser accessibility snapshots to AI agents, enabling deterministic web navigation, form testing, and Playwright test script generation without vision models.
requirements: MCP-compatible agent client (Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code)
steps: Instruct agent to navigate target web app
Agent interacts via accessibility tree refs
configSnippet: "Open https://example.com/login, test invalid password error states, and generate a Playwright TypeScript test file."
limitations: Canvas-heavy WebGL apps without semantic DOM/accessibility nodes require fallback coordinate actions.
